claim: A blind training-consistency residual (threshold 0.32) separates successful from failed S5 training runs: >= 95% of accepted runs succeed and <= 10% of rejected runs do.
limits: Measured 16/18 accepted succeeded, 6/22 rejected succeeded. Exploratory: AUC 0.904, so the residual is informative but not a gate; E006's relation-based score separated perfectly.
